architecture.context: same short50 + disjoint chunk10 x 30 and 64-dimensional latent; chunk/memory/context attention depths 2/4/4 at width 128, four heads; fresh predictor and retained context weights match the original initialization
architecture.input: ten historical and one current predictor token; each contains 71-D robot state, 8-D simulator foot height/velocity, 6-D contact force, 2-D contact state and the external 29-D physical PD joint target
architecture.normalization: robot state, physical target, simulator foot, contact force and robot delta statistics frozen immediately after warmup; theta is not normalized or replayed
architecture.physics: A alternates compiled nominal slots (no payload/DR/pulses) with frozen-tracker DR plus independent hand/mid-shin U(0,4kg) and original force pulses; B restores each exact A start into nominal physics without pulses and replays identical physical PD targets
architecture.rollout: predicted robot/foot/contact state is recursively fed back for five targets; the training/model hot path contains no articulated foot FK
architecture.transition: shared causal Transformer predicts normalized 70-D robot-state delta, normalized 8-D next foot state, normalized 6-D next contact force and 2-D next-contact logits, conditioned on a history-inferred dynamics latent

batch_a_rollout.domain_randomization_contract: 50% compiled nominal without payload or pulses; 50% original tracker DR plus four-limb payloads
batch_a_rollout.motion_contract: random motion resampling at initialization and reset

payload.force_pulse_scope: DR slots only; nominal timers disabled after every reset

nominal_mixture.layout: even local IDs nominal; odd local IDs DR

payload.sampling: even slots compiled nominal; odd slots original tracker DR plus independent U(0,4)^4

batch_a_rollout.reset_contract: asynchronous per-slot auto-reset; startup events are never reapplied
batch_a_rollout.reset_window_contract: the teleport boundary is excluded; the post-reset state may start a query

batch_b_rollout.physics: compiled checkpoint defaults with all DR events removed
batch_b_rollout.state_restore: clear sim/entity/action state; write local 71-D robot state; run zero-time sim.forward
batch_b_rollout.warmup: none; warmup would change the paired initial state

dataset.coverage: all recursive *.npz files; no exclusions or active subset
dataset.rank_partition: sorted files [rank::world_size], union equals full catalog

nominal_mixture.layout: even local IDs nominal; odd local IDs DR
even local IDs nominal; odd local IDs DR
even local IDs nominal; odd local IDs DR
even local IDs nominal; odd local IDs DR

matched_control.architecture_change: none; expanded 2/4/4 encoder on both sides
matched_control.conclusion_scope: one seed; joint effect of weak positive/negative losses and response scale
matched_control.initialization: fresh predictor and retained context weights plus subsequent RNG match original Memory350
matched_control.model_input: identical short50 plus nonoverlapping cross-reset chunk10 x 30

memory_contract.collector: Original replay plus a separate raw cross-motion archive for weak positives
memory_contract.representation_eligibility: Original local/response losses keep their eligibility; additional weak pairs require full short50 and long30
memory_contract.reset: preserve completed contiguous chunks; discard incomplete tails; clear and pad short history

method: nominal50 Memory350 encoder2x weak cross-motion positives and direct DR negatives v1

replay.history_storage: time archive reconstructed at sample time
replay.positive_pairs: same physical A world/episode/motion, exact +/-5-frame shift; identical Memory350 sample eligibility; full short history is not required
replay.predictor_sampling: broad ordinary replay; incomplete contexts remain eligible for prediction
replay.response_pairs: cross-world broad-replay pairs; normalized latent distance continuously matches five-step A-minus-nominal-B response distance without a threshold
replay.weak_positive_pairs: same fixed-physics world and session, different motion, disjoint full 350-step raw histories

representation_distance_diagnostics: Quantiles use eligible pairs in each rank's probe batch; distributed logs average rank-local quantiles and do not represent pooled global quantiles. Zero valid pairs produce zero diagnostics; inspect latent_relation_pairs alongside distances.

validation.contract: disjoint physical world IDs, independent loads/motions/starts/history; excluded from training and normalization
validation.convergence: at least 2000 updates; <1% best NMSE improvement over 1000 updates and latent diagnostic ranges <0.1
validation.nominal_metrics: separate nominal/DR held-out errors; each validation partition contains 50% nominal
validation.representation_probe: held-out exact +/-5-step positive pairs with any usable short or long history
validation.selection: minimum held-out five-step DR NMSE on broad contexts, including incomplete histories

weak_pair_contract.archive_dtype: float32 raw interactions; re-encoded with current weights
weak_pair_contract.negative: all distinct DR world pairs in a microbatch, full histories, no motion/phase matching
weak_pair_contract.negative_loss: mean(relu(margin - unit_L2_distance)^2) over unordered distinct DR pairs
weak_pair_contract.positive: same fixed-physics world and session, different motion, disjoint full 350-step raw histories
weak_pair_contract.positive_loss: mean(1 - cosine(unit_anchor, unit_positive)) over valid DR positives
